spans.text: Kaijou are a rare sight in Somnus Domina. Though there does not seem to be any sign of them dying out, it is uncommon to see more than a few even in major settlements, though some pockets of them exist in the form of tribes in the far reaches of the continent. The greatest cultural center for them is in the hidden world of the Cauldron, where a huge settlement called Rexfang Wall houses hundreds of them.

The kaijou warriors are vicious and imposing, but their appearance often belies a cunning streak of natural intelligence. While an academy kaijou is a rare sight, they are talented doctors, alchemists, and strategists.

Kaijou have a natural sense of kinship with dinosaurs, and their cultural gods of good and evil, Kilngresh and Aldinax respectively, are spoken of as titanic dinosaur-like figures of the land and sky. Many raise dinosaurs from birth to act as their companions and mounts. Despite their similarities to such beasts, Kaijou insist their similarities are akin to those of trolls and orcs: non-existant and irrelevant.
